steps.npc: Hello there young one. Interested in getting your hands dirty?
Ah don't worry, it's nothing sinister. We leave that kind of thing to clan Iorwerth. I speak in a more literal sense, of the ground beneath us and the trees over us.

steps.player: Oh, I see. So it's your clan that looks after the plants of the city?

steps.npc: Indeed. We maintain the farms and manage the trees. The produce we grow goes to the Meilyr clan to feed the city and the wood we provide is used by the Ithell clan in construction.
Feel free to join us. Our farming patches are open to you, as is our sawmill.
